assumptions: All existing upload infrastructure (localStorage, prompts, toasts) continues to work unchanged

No YAML schema changes needed - Uploads is synthetic/injected only

plan.overview: Restore file upload functionality by creating a dynamic 'Uploads' group that integrates seamlessly into the existing grouped mixin dropdown UI. The Uploads group will be synthetically injected after YAML parsing, positioned intelligently (top if uploads exist, bottom otherwise), and will include an 'Upload' text button in the group header. This approach reuses all existing upload infrastructure while leveraging the proven grouped UI architecture.

phases.name: Architecture & Design
phases.summary: Define the technical approach for Uploads group injection and positioning
phases.description:
Analyze and document the group injection strategy, data flow, and UI integration points:

1. **Identify injection point** - Find where toolbarComboState.groups is populated after YAML parsing (likely in applyComboGroupsToUI() or similar)
2. **Design Uploads group structure** - Define the synthetic group object format: {name: 'Uploads', items: [{label, value: 'uploaded::id'}], isUploads: true, isUploadsGroup: true}
3. **Define positioning logic** - When Uploads group should be injected (at index 0 if uploads exist, at end otherwise)
4. **Group header rendering strategy** - Where/how to add conditional 'Upload' button in toolbar-combo-group-header
5. **No bulk-select design** - Identify where group checkbox is rendered and how to suppress it for Uploads group
6. **State synchronization** - Plan how localStorage changes trigger group re-injection (e.g., after triggerToolbarComboUpload completes)
7. **Group item format** - Ensure uploaded items follow same item structure as other groups (for rendering, selection, etc.)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Clear diagram/pseudo-code showing group injection flow (YAML parse → inject Uploads → render dropdown)
Identified exact code location where groups are set up (line number + function name)
Group header rendering template identified and strategy for conditional upload button documented
Positioning algorithm documented: top if uploads exist, bottom otherwise
Identified how group checkbox suppression will work (DOM check? CSS? JS flag?)
State sync strategy documented (when/how to refresh group after upload action)

phases.name: Implement Group Injection Logic
phases.summary: Inject and manage the dynamic Uploads group in toolbarComboState
phases.description:
Implement the core logic to create and manage the Uploads group:

**Step 1: Create function injectUploadsGroup()**
- Called after parseGroupsFromYaml() populates toolbarComboState.groups
- Gets current uploads via getUploadedMixins()
- Creates synthetic group: {name: 'Uploads', items: [], isUploadsGroup: true}
- Populates items array from localStorage uploads
- Returns group object

**Step 2: Implement positioning logic**
- If Uploads group has items (uploads exist):
  - Insert at index 0 (top of group list)
- Else:
  - Append to end of toolbarComboState.groups array
- Ensure positioning happens after all YAML groups are parsed

**Step 3: Suppress group checkbox for Uploads group**
- In group header rendering template, check for isUploadsGroup flag
- Conditionally skip rendering toolbar-combo-group-checkbox for Uploads
- Preserve toggle button and group name

**Step 4: Add Upload button to group header**
- In group header template, after group name/toggle, add:
  - Create button element with text 'Upload'
  - Add CSS class for styling (reuse .tool-btn)
  - Wire click handler to triggerToolbarComboUpload()
  - Only render if isUploadsGroup === true

**Step 5: Update state synchronization**
- After triggerToolbarComboUpload() completes and new upload is added:
  - Trigger re-injection of Uploads group
  - Update toolbarComboState.groups
  - Call renderToolbarComboDropdown() to refresh UI
  - This ensures newly-uploaded items appear immediately

**Step 6: Handle removal from Uploads group**
- When user deselects an uploaded item from Selected Mixins:
  - Item is removed from toolbarComboState.selectedValues
  - But item remains in localStorage (doesn't delete)
  - Uploads group still shows it (user can manage via 'Manage Uploaded Mixins')

**Step 7: Filter/search compatibility**
- Ensure toolbar-combo-input filter applies to Uploads group items same as other groups
- No special handling needed (existing filter logic should work)

**Code files to modify:**
- ui/html/js/main.js: Add injectUploadsGroup() function, call after group parsing, update group header rendering template, wire upload button handler

acceptanceCriteria.text: injectUploadsGroup() function created and tested with mock data
Positioning logic correctly places Uploads group at top if items exist, bottom if empty

Upload button appears in Uploads group header with correct text and styling
Upload button click triggers triggerToolbarComboUpload() successfully
After new upload added, Uploads group automatically refreshes with new item
Existing uploads in localStorage appear in Uploads group on page load
Filter input correctly searches/filters items in Uploads group

phases.name: Integrate Upload Button Handler & State Management
phases.summary: Wire upload button to existing upload functions and ensure proper state updates
phases.description:
Implement the glue logic connecting the upload button to existing infrastructure:

**Step 1: Wire upload button click handler**
- Create event listener on Upload button (in group header)
- Call triggerToolbarComboUpload() on click
- Ensure preventDefault() to avoid dropdown closing unintentionally

**Step 2: Ensure Uploads group re-renders after upload**
- Hook into upload completion (after upsertUploadedMixin succeeds)
- Trigger refreshComboAfterStorageChange() or similar update mechanism
- Ensure injectUploadsGroup() is called to rebuild group with new items
- Call renderToolbarComboDropdown() to re-render UI

**Step 3: Handle Uploads group in group collapse/expand**
- Ensure Uploads group respects existing collapse state logic
- Can be collapsed/expanded like other groups
- Collapse state is managed by toggleGroupCollapse() (existing)
- No special handling needed

**Step 4: Ensure Uploads group respects group selection logic**
- When Uploads group is collapsed, toggle button works normally
- No select-all checkbox for Uploads (already suppressed in Phase 2)
- Individual items in Uploads can still be selected/deselected
- Selection state persists in toolbarComboState.selectedValues

**Step 5: Test integration with existing combo state**
- Verify Uploads group items work with getToolbarComboSelectionValues()
- Verify Uploads items can be added/removed from selectedValues
- Verify removeToolbarComboSelection() handles uploaded:: values
- Verify filtering works across all groups including Uploads

**Code changes:**
- ui/html/js/main.js: Bind upload button handler, integrate with triggerToolbarComboUpload(), ensure state refresh after upload

acceptanceCriteria.text: Upload button click handler is attached and calls triggerToolbarComboUpload()
After successful upload, Uploads group immediately shows new item in dropdown
Uploads group can be collapsed/expanded without errors

Filter/search input works on Uploads group items same as other groups
No JavaScript console errors during upload flow

phases.name: Integration Testing & Validation
phases.summary: Manual testing to verify Uploads group functionality and integration
phases.description:
Perform comprehensive manual testing to ensure all functionality works correctly:

**Test Scenario 1: Initial Load with Existing Uploads**
- Pre-populate localStorage with some uploaded mixins
- Load page
- Verify: Uploads group appears at top of dropdown with items listed
- Verify: Uploads group header shows 'Upload' button
- Verify: No select-all checkbox visible for Uploads group

**Test Scenario 2: Initial Load with No Uploads**
- Clear localStorage of uploaded mixins
- Load page
- Verify: Uploads group appears at bottom/end of mixin list
- Verify: Uploads group is empty (no items)
- Verify: Upload button still present and clickable

**Test Scenario 3: Upload New File**
- With dropdown open, click Upload button in Uploads group
- Select a YAML file
- Verify: File upload dialog appears and works (existing functionality)
- Verify: After upload completes, Uploads group refreshes and new item appears immediately
- Verify: New item is selectable from dropdown
- Verify: Toast notification shows (existing)

**Test Scenario 4: Select Uploaded Item**
- Upload a new mixin
- From Uploads group, select (checkbox click) the uploaded item
- Verify: Item appears in 'Selected Mixins' panel
- Verify: SVG diagram updates to include the uploaded mixin

**Test Scenario 5: Group Collapse/Expand**
- Click toggle button on Uploads group header
- Verify: Group collapses, items hidden
- Verify: Toggle button rotates/changes state
- Click again to expand
- Verify: Items reappear

**Test Scenario 6: Filter/Search with Uploads**
- Add multiple uploads
- Type search term in toolbar-combo-input
- Verify: Uploads group items are filtered same as other groups
- Verify: Only matching items show

**Test Scenario 7: Upload Multiple Times**
- Upload several files in sequence
- Verify: Each upload adds item to Uploads group
- Verify: No duplicate items
- Verify: Items persist when page is reloaded

**Test Scenario 8: Manage Uploaded Mixins Button Still Works**
- Click 'Manage Uploaded Mixins' button (separate toolbar button)
- Verify: Popup shows all uploaded mixins
- Verify: Can remove items from popup
- Verify: After removal, item is gone from Uploads group too
- Verify: Uploads group re-syncs correctly

**Test Scenario 9: Compatibility with Other Groups**
- Verify: Other mixin groups (if any) still work normally
- Verify: Uploading doesn't break group collapse/expand of other groups
- Verify: Filtering applies to all groups uniformly

**Test Scenario 10: Edge Cases**
- Upload file, then refresh page → verify item persists
- Upload file, remove via Manage popup, refresh → verify removed
- Create permalink with selected uploads → verify it works
- Remove all uploads, reload page → verify Uploads group appears at end (empty)
